# Native status bars

Original MIT PE32 fixture for COMCTL32 status bars, named A/W creation and
ordinal 6, ANSI/Unicode text, multipart/simple persistence, packed text results,
part boundaries, native simple-mode and NMMOUSE callbacks, tooltips, background
color and parent resizing. The fixed second bar uses CCS_NORESIZE and tabbed text.

Copyright (c) 2026 WineBrowser contributors. Licensed under the repository MIT
license. Icons, owner-drawn parts and a native resize grip remain unsupported.
